notes.title: Early Access Patch notes 0.6.1.0 23th December 2024
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce an update for the game just before Christmas holidays.

In this update we have performed a second step of improvements on the Paris Arena Stadium, now we have crowd and the ambience is rising up.

We fixed some issues related to ranking in tournaments, now both local and online tournaments (i.e. with leaderboards) are properly accounting the progression, don't hesitate to try them, as in the future some of the content will be unlockable with the ranking points, 

Meanwhile will you be able to be in the top 12 players ?

Let's enjoy volleyball at its best in virtual reality !

GAMEPLAY

 Fixed issues with Tournaments and rankings, both local and online rankings are displayed
 Fixed ball speed not recorded in leaderboards
 2nd pass of improvements on Paris Arena Stadium (there will be a third :))

notes.title: Update 6 enhances the volleyball skills of players and add a new character

Can you achieve victory against them on hard and pro difficulty levels ?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42100003/b8d4e50e1806815e313f37b81bbc049ee6b0d139.jpg

This winter, and let's have fun on the virtual volleyball court !

notes.title: Early Access Patch notes 0.5.0.2 28 August 2024
notes.content:
We are pleased to release this minor update that will improve game balance and add some usefull profiles for different VR space configurations.

Gameplay

Added Roomscale profile for VR Position
This functionality was previously accessible by manually configuring multiple options. For user convenience, we have now introduced predefined position profiles that automatically set the necessary options.
The Roomscale profile is perfect for VR Arcades or large play areas, as it allows you to be fully in control of your movement without any teleports or assistance.

Added VR Teleports settings menu
We moved the teleport options and the auto look at ball option into this main menu option, so that you can change them for all the matches (online, local). 
The VR Position profile setting is also saved and loaded so you don't need to reapply them.
The VR Position selected at boot will predefine theses options depending on the profile selected (seated, standing, roomscale).

Added Smooth turn option for controllers
Some of the players wished to have smooth movement for turning, in the teleport setting we have added an option for smooth turn instead of snap turn when rotating with the controller.

Difficulty level balancing
After the recent adjustments, we found it necessary to restore some balance to the easy and medium difficulty levels, this is a work that will be ongoing for a few updates.

Misc
Various quality of life fixes.
Fix for orientation shifted when Ending a Set with no teleports and or no autolook enabled.
Fix for case where the torso of online avatar could be opposite to the head orientation

We hope you will like it, enjoy volleyball !

notes.title: Update 5 is bringing 4 VS 4 Single player and 2 VS 2 Online multiplayer
notes.content:
Summer is the perfect season for outdoor volleyball, but we're dedicated to improving Highline, working tirelessly to enhance your gaming experience for the upcoming autumn and winter.

We have some great news, today we are excited to deliver the 0.5 version of our game,

The game's update pace has recently decelerated as we've tackled complex features. After months of dedicated effort, here are the exciting changes:

Online multiplayer

2 vs 2 game mode
Previously we added the 1 VS 1 with multi touches (passing onto self, for allowing attacks) but now we are adding the 2 vs 2 mode where each online player is in a team and has a cpu assisted teammate.
Online avatar hand orientation fix


Single player

4 vs 4 game mode
In this mode your play area is smaller and you have more teammates to assist, however you need to have more strategies to be able to win.
Front Block behavior for Joey
Our surfer is getting this new skill, this is changing a lot the matches especially in 4 vs 4.
This behavior will be further improved in later patches.


Engine
Various optimizations and quality fixes

What's next ?
We will have a series of minor patches before reaching update 6.
We can't wait to release the update 6, more content and gameplay will be added.

Enjoy Volleyball !

notes.title: Update 4 And Online Multiplayer 1 VS 1
notes.content:
Great news, 

Update 4 is here and brings up many additions.

We have been working hard with a main focus to implement the core functionalities for online multiplayer, this is a stepping stone for more elaborated gameplays.

We are also improving hand interactions and single player behaviors.

Here is a detailed list of improvement :

Experimental 1 VS 1 Online multiplayer

In this game mode you are allowed to perform consecutive touches, as an example you can set yourself for a spike.

Private (friends only) and public lobbies along with a spectator mode are available, 
Up to 2 spectators can join your games.

Gameplay

 The auto teleport has been improved and is now detecting automatically the kind of reception to perform based on your hand posture : 
simply join both hands under the chest for a platform/bump , or keep hands appart for a set or high pass.
Some volleyballs models has been added to further personnalize your games.
We introduced some temporary voice effects for adding life to the games.
 Underhand serve is easier, now you can perform an underhand serve by just closing the fist and hitting from below the ball when it's attached to the other hand.


Engine
Optimizations

Miscellaneous
Various fixes has been performed

For any feedback about this update or the game please use the steam forums or join our discord.

Enjoy Volleyball !

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
This update is the third milestone of the early access of Highline Volleyball VR.

In this update we have added a new environment called "Synth Court".
This is a court themed on the 80's synthwave art and music style.

This court is also the first environment that is unlockable with a certain rank (510+) opening the door to some career progression and discovery through online or offline ranking.

Originally we planned to deliver also a new behavior on AI for this update : Blocking, and some gamemode events but we are a bit late on it,  because we have been busy to work on the fundations of multiplayer game modes and we did made some good progress over it (lobbies, voice chat, head/torso/hands replication).

We may open the gamemode as an experimental version at one point so that you can try it out. 

The blocking behavior and the game mode events are still scheduled for 0.3 , during the minor updates.

Enjoy volleyball !

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
This update is the first milestone of the Early access since the release. 
It is adding a new volleyball player and a new environment along several improvements to the game, with some major improvements in a lot of areas thanks to the feedback of the community.

Here is the full list of the improvements :

ENVIRONMENT

 Added 4th environment : Eden Rock Court


GAMEPLAY


 Added a new volleyball player : Alice with 2 skin variations
 Service ball attach/deattach is done by holding or releasing the left controller trigger.
 Added court side start option
 Added closed fist bump hit, hold grip/side triggers to close your fist, you can now use this during a serve for performing an underhand service for example or at anytime just for fun
 Added inertia on jumps and 1st person knee bending movement
 Jump height is now variable, the player will jump higher if far from the net and running.
 Improved hand response coherency for ball hits
 Added Blocking auto teleport when being near the net, this allows for blocking the ball at the net when jumping
 Added 1st ball miss animation
 Improved teammate behavior
 Added collision on head and torso of the VR Player
 Added difficulty levels easy/medium/hard
 Better placement for Spike attacks


GAME ENGINE

 Multithreading optimizations
 Fixed a potential rare game boot crash due to asynchronous loading

ISSUES / FEATURE REQUEST / FEEDBACK ?

We loved to have feedback about our game and we are constantly trying to improve it, so help us by getting in touch on Discord, or steam forums.

Thank you for playing this game and enjoy Volleyball !
